mapper.select: SELECT 1 AS sectionId, C.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID AS id, '-1000' AS parentId, C.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID AS mdfmCpemNo, 'ENTITY' AS classType, 'LABEL' AS controlType, NULL AS maskingType, C.NR_ITEM_CTG_NM AS content, NULL AS "desc", NULL AS style FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAE A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM B ON A.NR_ITEM_ID = B.NR_ITEM_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.MDREC_VWR_PRNT_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRICD C ON B.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID = C.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.LST_YN = 'Y' AND C.NREC_CLS_CD = '01' WHERE A.NREC_ID = #{keyId} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.NREC_DTL_ID, C.SORT_SEQ, B.SORT_SEQ

SELECT 1 AS sectionId, B.NR_ITEM_ID AS id, C.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID AS parentId, B.NR_ITEM_ID AS mdfmCpemNo, 'ATTRIBUTE' AS classType, 'LABEL' AS controlType, NULL AS maskingType, B.NR_ITEM_NM AS content, NULL AS "desc", NULL AS style FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAE A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM B ON A.NR_ITEM_ID = B.NR_ITEM_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.MDREC_VWR_PRNT_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRICD C ON B.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID = C.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.LST_YN = 'Y' AND C.NREC_CLS_CD = '01' WHERE A.NREC_ID = #{keyId} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.NREC_DTL_ID, C.SORT_SEQ, B.SORT_SEQ

SELECT 1 AS sectionId, A.NREC_DTL_ID AS id, B.NR_ITEM_ID AS parentId, A.NREC_DTL_ID AS mdfmCpemNo, 'VALUE' AS classType, CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.REC_CNTE) >= 50 THEN 'RICH_TEXT_BOX' ELSE 'TEXT_BOX' END AS controlType, CASE WHEN B.NR_ITEM_ID = 55 THEN 'STAFF_NUMBER' ELSE NULL END AS maskingType, A.REC_CNTE AS content, NULL AS "desc", NULL AS style FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAE A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM B ON A.NR_ITEM_ID = B.NR_ITEM_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.MDREC_VWR_PRNT_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRICD C ON B.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID = C.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.LST_YN = 'Y' AND C.NREC_CLS_CD = '01' WHERE A.NREC_ID = #{keyId} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.NREC_DTL_ID, C.SORT_SEQ, B.SORT_SEQ
